context: Checks the plan follows the nx-plugin-authoring workflow: scaffold, generator, EJS templates, tests and real-workspace validation.

checklist.name: Adds the plugin package to the workspace
checklist.description: The plan includes `npx nx add @nx/plugin` or uses `npx create-nx-plugin` for a new workspace.

checklist.name: Generates the plugin project
checklist.description: The plan includes `npx nx g plugin tools/<name>` (or the create-nx-plugin equivalent).

checklist.name: Generates the generator
checklist.description: The plan includes `npx nx g generator <plugin>/src/generators/<name>`.

checklist.name: Templates use EJS placeholders
checklist.description: The plan describes templates with EJS syntax such as `<%= name %>` under a `files/` directory.

checklist.name: Template variables supplied
checklist.description: The plan passes template variables (for example `names(schema.name)`) to `generateFiles`.

checklist.name: Template filename suffix handled
checklist.description: The plan mentions the `.template` suffix and the `tmpl: ""` variable to strip it.

checklist.name: Unit tests with an in-memory workspace
checklist.description: The plan includes tests using `createTreeWithEmptyWorkspace` and runs `npx nx test <plugin>`.

checklist.name: Real workspace validation
checklist.description: The plan validates in a real workspace with `--dry-run` and then runs the generator or target.

checklist.name: Small composable generators
checklist.description: The plan keeps the first release to one small generator and says later generators should be composed rather than one large generator.

checklist.name: Plugin is orchestration only
checklist.description: The plan states the plugin orchestrates scaffolding and does not hold business logic.

checklist.name: Registered in index and generators.json
checklist.description: The plan includes exporting the generator and registering it in `generators.json`.
